title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 145
description: Ten questions on Psalms 145: unsearchable greatness, an everlasting kingdom, and the God who opens his hand to every living thing.

questions.text: How often does the psalmist say he will praise God?
questions.explanation: He says, "Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever."

answers.text: Every morning and evening
Every day
Seven times a day
On every Sabbath

questions.text: What does the psalm say about Yahweh's greatness?
questions.explanation: It says, "Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable."

answers.text: It is higher than the heavens
It is told by the stars
It is feared by all kings
It is unsearchable

questions.text: What will one generation do for another?
questions.explanation: One generation will commend God's works to another, and will declare his mighty acts.

answers.text: Teach the law and statutes to the strangers
Build altars of remembrance in the land
Commend God's works and declare his mighty acts
Pass on the songs of David to their sons

questions.explanation: It says Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

answers.text: Gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness
Holy, jealous, and mighty in battle against his foes
A consuming fire and a God who hides himself from men
Just, severe, and always quick to judge the nations

questions.text: Over what are Yahweh's tender mercies?
questions.explanation: The psalm says Yahweh is good to all, and his tender mercies are over all his works.

answers.text: Israel alone
The humble only
Those who keep his covenant
All his works

questions.text: What kind of kingdom does God have, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: It says, "Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations."

answers.text: A kingdom of priests
An everlasting kingdom
A divided kingdom restored
A kingdom above all gods

questions.text: What does Yahweh do for all who fall?
questions.explanation: The psalm says Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

answers.text: He upholds them
He forgives them seven times
He carries them on eagles' wings
He sends his angels to them

questions.text: What happens when God opens his hand?
questions.explanation: The psalm says, "You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing."

answers.text: He scatters his enemies
He pours out rain on the earth
He satisfies the desire of every living thing
He gives wisdom to the simple

questions.explanation: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

answers.text: All who dwell in Zion
All who offer sacrifices
All who are pure in heart
All who call on him in truth

questions.explanation: It says Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

answers.text: He blesses the rich but remembers the poor
He preserves those who love him but will destroy all the wicked
He heals the sick but tests the healthy
He hears the humble but delays for the proud
